name: Poytta
description: Poytta was a planet in Hutt Space along a small hyperspace route situated alongside the Shag Pabol; as such, it was used as a refueling stop by many slavers and smugglers who travelled along the bigger hyperlane. It also served as Tuga SalPivo's base of operations.
